capabilities: Comment on a selected passage or cursor position of any note
Write, reply and navigate comment threads in a side panel
Classify comments into coloured categories that add and remove tags automatically
Display comments in the margin beside their passage
Extract comments into a separate note as a list, table or Kanban board
extras: Works in Live Preview only (markers hidden in reading view); full documentation lives at hypomnema.tools; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built the optional margin and extraction features on the principle that "an annotation tool should help you take your thinking back, not keep it for you", tied to the idea of "operational dispossession".
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach comments to specific passages of a note without cluttering the text with inline markers or footnotes.

relations.evidence: It works especially well with web articles saved through the Obsidian Web Clipper
